description: Send outbound email as marvin@iancoley.org via Mailgun, and read the Marvin label on Ian's Gmail via IMAP

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from marvin@iancoley.org via Mailgun. Requires MAILGUN_API_KEY and MAILGUN_DOMAIN in config/.env.

from_name.description: Display name for the From header (default: Marvin)

tools.name: read_marvin_folder
tools.description: Read new messages from the 'Marvin' label in Ian's Gmail via IMAP. Returns only messages not seen on a previous call (tracked by UID in a local state file) — doesn't mark anything read/unread in Gmail itself. Requires GMAIL_ADDRESS and GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD in config/.env.

include_seen.description: If true, return every message in the folder regardless of what's already been processed (default: false — only new messages since the last call)
